# glad
add_subdirectory(glad)

# glfw
if(NOT USE_SHARED_GLFW)
# disable glfw test, docs and examples
	set(GLFW_BUILD_DOCS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	set(GLFW_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	set(GLFW_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	add_subdirectory(glfw)
endif()

#glm
if(NOT USE_SHARED_GLM)
	# set(GLM_TEST_ENABLE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	# add_subdirectory(glm) header only
endif()

#assimp
if(NOT USE_SHARED_ASSIMP)
	set(ASSIMP_BUILD_ASSIMP_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	set(ASSIMP_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	add_subdirectory(assimp)
endif()

#bullet3
if(NOT USE_SHARED_BULLET3)
	set(USE_GRAPHICAL_BENCHMARK OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	OPTION(BUILD_CPU_DEMOS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	OPTION(BUILD_ENET OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	OPTION(BUILD_CLSOCKET OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	OPTION(BUILD_OPENGL3_DEMOS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	OPTION(BUILD_BULLET2_DEMOS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	OPTION(BUILD_EXTRAS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	OPTION(INSTALL_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	OPTION(BUILD_UNIT_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
	OPTION(INSTALL_CMAKE_FILES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endif()
